regime_notes: A meaningful new non-portfolio alert crossed the framework threshold: Fetch.ai/FET and NuNet/NTX suffered a linked security incident. The FET converter path relied on a compromised single-EOA authorization and lacked an on-chain burn/lock proof on conversionIn; the same attacker cluster was linked to unauthorized NTX minted from the NuNet deployer account. FET is rejected for a new entry pending containment/postmortem and NTX fails the privileged-mint/deployer-control gate outright.

The AI theme has not uniformly unwound: the broad CoinGecko AI category remains modestly positive while Bittensor Subnets are outperforming it. TAO and several subnets retain relative leadership, but no fresh independent selective-wallet cohort was verified, so there is no TAO paper starter.

Hyperliquid remains the strongest broad continuation regime: stablecoin supply is about +5.23% over seven days, spot DEX volume about +19.39% weekly and perps about +34.51%. This strengthens the existing HYPE thesis but does not add the missing independent wallet leg, and the Oct. 6 contributor unlock remains a material caveat.

Polygon remains the largest raw weekly DEX acceleration at about +134%, but 24h net flows are negative and POL remains structurally rejected under the previously identified privileged adjustable mint-cap gate.

Arbitrum's DEX/perp growth remains contradicted by negative stablecoin growth and roughly -$97M of 24h net flows. Solana, Base, BSC, Avalanche and Sui do not show a clean enough combination of retained stablecoin capital and spot acceleration to justify a new paper position.

NEAR's large price/Intents move remains explicitly incentive-contaminated by the NEAR@3.33 milestone program, which rewards the same confidential balance/swap/TVL behaviors and conditions reward conversion on a 3-day VWAP threshold. No NEAR paper action is permitted from that flow until post-incentive persistence is demonstrated.

Marked paper NAV is approximately $10,572.89 versus $10,215.63 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by about $357.26 or 349.72 bps. UNI is about 7.25% of NAV, ZEC about 6.98%, HYPE about 5.12% and AERO about 2.66%. No paper trade is justified; state.json and the immutable trade ledger remain unchanged.
